OpenAI-compatible gateway. 300+ models (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, dsb).
Searches public X posts. Billing uses 1 Xquik credit per returned post.

OpenAI-compatible aggregator. One API key reaches every model, billed per-token from a prepaid wallet. Model ids are bare (e.g. claude-opus-5.5, gpt-6-astra, deepseek-v4.1-flash:free) and are fetched live from the provider.
OpenAI-compatible Gonka inference node. Small, fixed catalogue (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, MiniMax-M2.7) at a flat per-token rate.
OpenAI-compatible endpoint from Atria Dawn (AtomInnoLab). Currently a research preview offering a single text model, Atria-Dawn-Preview.
OpenAI-compatible gateway with one of the larger catalogues here. Accepts a bearer token or an x-api-key header. Model ids are fetched live from the provider.
v1m System One calibrated decision engine. Fast probabilistic evaluations over state and questions.

Two ways to authenticate, both entered in the AWS Bedrock Credentials section below. SSO / profile (recommended): fill in Profile and Region, leave the API key empty, then run `aws sso login --profile <name>` — credentials refresh automatically. Static keys: put the AWS secret access key in the API Key field and the key id in Access Key ID, adding Session Token if they are temporary (ASIA…) keys. A profile, if set, takes precedence over static keys.

xAI Grok models hosted on AWS Bedrock. Authenticate exactly like the AWS Bedrock provider: fill in Profile and Region and leave the API key empty, then run `aws sso login --profile <name>`; or use static keys with the AWS secret access key as the API key. Note Grok is a reasoning model and spends output budget thinking before it answers — a small max_tokens returns finish_reason "length" with empty content, so allow a few thousand tokens.

veoaifree-web.authHint: No credentials needed — veoaifree.com free tier (about 6 requests/hour per IP)

notice.text: Drex decision models on the System One protocol (noul / choice / score questions, calibrated probabilities). drex-max also accepts a top-level `images` array; drex-v2.0 is text-only. Paste a console.nace.ai API key (sent as a Bearer token).

grok-web.name: Grok Web (Subscription)
grok-web.authHint: Paste your full grok.com Cookie header (sso + cf_clearance — needed for image/video generation)

perplexity-web.name: Perplexity Web (Pro/Max)
perplexity-web.authHint: Paste your __Secure-next-auth.session-token cookie value from perplexity.ai

deepseek-web.name: DeepSeek Web
deepseek-web.authHint: Paste your userToken from chat.deepseek.com localStorage (DevTools → Application → Local Storage)

gemini-web.name: Gemini Web
gemini-web.authHint: Paste your __Secure-1PSID (and __Secure-1PSIDTS) cookie value(s) from gemini.google.com

muse-web.name: Muse Web
muse-web.authHint: Paste your muse.ai cookies (hatch_sess=...; hatch_gw=...; hatch_vml=...; hatch_native_auth_device=...) from a logged-in muse.ai session

chatgpt-web.name: ChatGPT Web
chatgpt-web.authHint: Paste your chatgpt.com cookie header containing __Secure-next-auth.session-token (or a full Playwright storage-state JSON)

uc-web.name: UC Web
uc-web.authHint: Paste your full uncensored.com Cookie header (must include the __client cookie) from a logged-in session — image + video are un-metered on the web plan
